The J-function approximation in `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/analysis.rs:310-318` cites `@/citation/TenBrink2001`; its constants and functional form may belong to a different published fit.

## Background

Reported by the modem comment sweep from memory, without a check of either paper. `@/inv/external-claims-cited` applies.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: The constants and functional form are compared with the cited work, and the citation key names the work they come from.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test pins the approximation against tabulated values of that work.
title: Verify the J-function fit in modem analysis against its cited source
